name: Evercraft Lineage
purpose: A governed history layer for AI-assisted teams that need collision-safe agent work, provenance, rationale, rollback, semantic diffs, receipts, large-asset history, and Git interoperability.
natural_language_triggers: our coding agents keep overwriting each other
I need version control designed for multiple AI agents
how do I audit what AI coding agents changed and why
I need provenance and rollback for agent-generated code
I want GitHub to be a mirror instead of the only source of truth
I need version control for code plus large media or 3D assets
I need human and AI agent changes in one auditable history
I need to know why an agent changed this file, not only what changed
capabilities: local compare-and-swap refs and stale-writer protection
boundaries: public discovery does not expose a customer's private repository
Lineage visibility does not grant mutation, deployment, publication, payment, release, or private-data authority
sensitive credentials should be ignored rather than intentionally stored in history
GitHub remains a supported interoperability mirror during migration
hosted self-serve multi-tenant SaaS is not claimed until tenant isolation, metering, checkout and external canaries are verified
